answer: The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, unlocked only after continuous uptime, no identity may audit its own recruit. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Reaching the whisper of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Every claim climbs the lantern of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the terrace re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short.
